card.name: Numbers inside dosing tables
card.fires_on: Digits, closing brackets, dashes and units inside flattened dosing tables, where cells of numbers run together without words. It fires on the cell value itself, often a digit partway through a number.

modes.label: Digits in table cells
modes.description: A digit or part of a number inside a row of weights, doses or volumes.

modes.label: Dashes and brackets as cell separators
modes.description: A dash or closing parenthesis that separates or fills a table cell.
modes.example: 2 ) Intravenous Dosing Schedule: 0 Hours 4 Hours 8 Hours Ifosfamide 1.2 g/m 2 --<< -->> Mesna injection 240 mg

card.plain: It marks numbers and filler marks in the cells of dose tables that have been flattened into plain text.
